import pandas as pd

xls = pd.ExcelFile('sales_data.xlsx')
print("Sheets:", xls.sheet_names)
for sheet in xls.sheet_names:
    df = pd.read_excel(xls, sheet_name=sheet, header=None, nrows=8)

import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

ns = {'m': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'}

with zipfile.ZipFile('sales_data.xlsx') as z:
    print("FILES IN ARCHIVE:")
    for n in z.namelist():
        print(" ", n)
    print()
    sheet_xml = [n for n in z.namelist() if n.startswith('xl/worksheets/')]
    print("Worksheet files:", sheet_xml)
    for path in sheet_xml:
        root = ET.fromstring(z.read(path))
        print(f"\n=== {path} ===")
        sheetdata = root.find('m:sheetData', ns)
        for row in sheetdata.findall('m:row', ns)[:6]:
            r = row.get('r')
            cells = []
            for c in row.findall('m:c', ns):
                ref = c.get('r')
                t = c.get('t')
                v = c.find('m:v', ns)
                val = v.text if v is not None else None
                f = c.find('m:f', ns)
                formula = f.text if f is not None else None
                cells.append(f"{ref}[t={t} v={val!r} f={formula!r}]")
            print(f"row {r}: {cells}")
    # shared strings
    if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in z.namelist():
        sst = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
        vals = []
        for si in sst.findall('m:si', ns):
            texts = [t.text or '' for t in si.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t')]
            vals.append(''.join(texts))
        print("\nShared strings:", vals[:50])

import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

M = '{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}'

def inline_text(c):
    is_ = c.find(M+'is')
    if is_ is None:
        return None
    return ''.join(t.text or '' for t in is_.iter(M+'t'))

with zipfile.ZipFile('sales_data.xlsx') as z:
    root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))
    print("sheet root attrs:", root.attrib)
    sd = root.find(M+'sheetData')
    rows = sd.findall(M+'row')
    print("num rows:", len(rows))
    for row in rows:
        r = row.get('r')
        cells = []
        for c in row.findall(M+'c'):
            ref = c.get('r')
            t = c.get('t')
            s = c.get('s')
            v = c.find(M+'v')
            f = c.find(M+'f')
            val = v.text if v is not None else None
            formula = f.text if f is not None else None
            txt = inline_text(c)
            cells.append(f"{ref}[t={t} s={s} v={val!r} f={formula!r} txt={txt!r}]")
        print(f"row {r}: {cells}")
    print("\n--- styles.xml (cellXfs) ---")
    st = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/styles.xml'))
    xfs = st.find(M+'cellXfs')
    for i, xf in enumerate(xfs.findall(M+'xf')):
        print(i, xf.attrib)
    print("\n--- numFmts ---")
    nfs = st.find(M+'numFmts')
    if nfs is not None:
        for nf in nfs.findall(M+'numFmt'):
            print(nf.attrib)
    print("\n--- workbook.xml ---")
    wb = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
    print(ET.tostring(wb, encoding='unicode')[:2000])

import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

M = '{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}'
NS = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'
ET.register_namespace('', NS)

src = 'sales_data.xlsx'
zin = zipfile.ZipFile(src, 'r')

# ---- sheet1.xml ----
sheet = ET.fromstring(zin.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))

dim = sheet.find(M+'dimension')
dim.set('ref', 'A1:H10')

cols = sheet.find(M+'cols')
col = ET.SubElement(cols, M+'col')
col.set('width', '12'); col.set('customWidth', '1')
col.set('min', '8'); col.set('max', '8')

sd = sheet.find(M+'sheetData')
rows = {r.get('r'): r for r in sd.findall(M+'row')}

# Header
hdr = ET.SubElement(rows['1'], M+'c')
hdr.set('r', 'H1'); hdr.set('s', '1'); hdr.set('t', 'inlineStr')
is_ = ET.SubElement(hdr, M+'is')
t = ET.SubElement(is_, M+'t')
t.text = 'Profit Margin (%)'

# Data rows 2..9 and TOTAL row 10
for rnum in range(2, 11):
    c = ET.SubElement(rows[str(rnum)], M+'c')
    c.set('r', f'H{rnum}'); c.set('s', '3')
    f = ET.SubElement(c, M+'f')
    f.text = f'G{rnum}/E{rnum}'

new_sheet = ET.tostring(sheet, encoding='utf-8', xml_declaration=False)

# ---- styles.xml ----
styles = ET.fromstring(zin.read('xl/styles.xml'))

numfmts = styles.find(M+'numFmts')
numfmts.set('count', '1')
nf = ET.SubElement(numfmts, M+'numFmt')
nf.set('numFmtId', '164'); nf.set('formatCode', '0.0%')

xfs = styles.find(M+'cellXfs')
xfs.set('count', '4')
xf = ET.SubElement(xfs, M+'xf')
xf.set('numFmtId', '164'); xf.set('fontId', '0'); xf.set('fillId', '0')
xf.set('borderId', '0'); xf.set('pivotButton', '0'); xf.set('quotePrefix', '0')
xf.set('xfId', '0'); xf.set('applyNumberFormat', '1')

new_styles = ET.tostring(styles, encoding='utf-8', xml_declaration=False)

# ---- rebuild zip preserving all other entries byte-for-byte ----
with zipfile.ZipFile(src, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for item in zin.infolist():
        if item.filename == 'xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml':
            zout.writestr(item, new_sheet)
        elif item.filename == 'xl/styles.xml':
            zout.writestr(item, new_styles)
        else:
            zout.writestr(item, zin.read(item.filename))
zin.close()

print("done")
